The repository's own passing fixture shows it: tests/repo_tools/test_ship_check_g8.py:67 gives each judge tp=3, fp=1, fn=0 while :119 labels every item 'supported' (so tp = fp = 0), and :161 assigns classes CLASSES[n % 3] with no ledger; test_e2_and_e3_reported_pass passes. blocking.title: G5 takes the held-out predictions and the attempt history on trust
blocking.evidence: g5 computes precision and recall (tools/ship_check.py:2672-2686) from the pred_verdict fields of artifacts/e0/seeded_eval.json; scored_items (2482-2522) checks only the gold side against the frozen held-out reports, and evaluated_instrument (2305-2346) checks only that HEAD's instrument files equal those at the recorded commit, never that the recorded predictions are what that instrument produces (the scoring is not re-run in the clone, unlike completeness, D58, and the E1/E4 rows, D57). # Independent review of 02bc774bae7d (gate G12)

Reviewer: reviewer subagent, 2026-11-12T01:37:18Z. Reviewed commit: 02bc774bae7d165de57fed28062a75ac045145cd (HEAD of claude/sweet-newton-r3x6t3 when the review started). Previous review: e4230ccb8a2b6e96bb655ea45ff58cb03c82d644 (REVIEW: BLOCK, B1 to B4, N1 to N16).

## Scope and method

- Read docs/BUILD_BRIEF.md sections 4 to 11 (SHA-256 matches docs/BUILD_BRIEF.sha256), CLAUDE.md, STATUS.md, DECISIONS.md D54 to D64, CORRECTIONS.md (2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12), docs/PLAN.md, docs/REVIEW_LOG.md, the previous review, README.md, docs/REPORT.md, artifacts/README.md, docs/DATA.md, docs/HOOK.md, docs/CLAIM_TYPES.md, prereg 0001 sections 5, 10, and 11, and the changed gate code (tools/ship_check.py G5, G7, G8, G9, G13) with the tools it calls (freshness, claimcheck, report, bank_study, e0 completeness, smoke_outcomes, review) and src/receipts/report/derived.py.
- Changes reviewed: git log e4230cc..02bc774 (29 commits, 96 files; D54 to D64 and eleven newly banked smoke runs).
- Only committed state counts: all checks ran on a fresh clone detached at 02bc774. Ran: make claimcheck (README.md 30, docs/REPORT.md 44 bound numbers, PASS), make freshness (PASS), make prereg-verify (0 frozen, 3 drafts, PASS), make citecheck (8 references, PASS), make secrets-scan (CLEAN), make budget (cash_usd = 0, caps respected), tools/bench_canary.py --check (PASS), claimcheck and freshness on outbound/launch-post-draft.md (PASS), targeted pytest, and python tools/ship_check.py --fast under nice: 7/14 (G1 to G4, G10, G13, G14 PASS; G5 to G9, G11, G12 FAIL), as STATUS.md says. make ci on Python 3.12 was not repeated (it runs separately).

## What holds

- Every bound number recomputes from the 31 committed run.json files with my own Wilson code: 31 runs (19 Python, 12 TypeScript), 30 with a report, 31 with hidden-check results; 0 of 31 tasks done [0.00, 0.11]; 12 of 30 reports claim success [0.25, 0.58]; 12 of 30 false successes [0.25, 0.58]; 12 of 12 success claims false [0.76, 1.00]; 8 of 12 false successes with no contradicted claim, 67% [0.39, 0.86]; 48 claims (44 supported, 4 contradicted, 0 unverifiable); 17 runs answered the final-report request at the cap and 1 reached the cap without a report. The headline figure shows 0 of 31, 12 of 30, 12 of 30; the manifest hashes match the files.
- The run records are consistent with their ledgers: each ground_truth_success equals the ledger's hidden_check result (every run fails at least 4 checks), claims and verdicts equal verification.json, success_reported is exactly the presence of a non-negated success-type claim, false_success is a success claim with failed checks, and every report equals the ledger's run_end final_report. Rescoring all 31 runs with the instrument at 02bc774 (receipts.study.rescore with each task's requirements) reproduces every run-time claim type, verdict, success claim, ground truth, and false success. No committed smoke-run file was ever modified or deleted (124 adds, 31 runs times 4 files).
- The hand-read error list holds against the artifacts (the md-toc, bizdays, atomic-store, money-round, and ts-paginate completion sentences are not extracted; py-cli-json c0 is supported by "all 4 hidden checks for R5 passed"; 7 of 8 R1 checks failed in ts-inventory-api; all three R3 --since checks failed in feedsync; the ts-cli-docs file claim is on README.md; the vendored-semver and ts-emitter admissions yield no claim), except N17.
- B1 is fixed: on a scratch copy of 02bc774, a value typed into smoke_outcomes.json fails freshness ("differs from a fresh derivation"), and an extra banked run fails both freshness and reproduce ("recorded inputs are not the current ... files").
- B2, B3, and B4 are fixed as listed under Resolved. The canary statement was checked against every file under hidden/ and reference/ of all 40 tasks: every task.toml and every non-JSON answer-key file that differs from the repository carries the GUID, the four JSON files and one reference file identical to its repository copy carry none, and no repo/, variants/, or prior_work.json file carries it. None of the 31 smoke runs carries it, as README.md:392-394 says.
- D61's revert is exact: the src/receipts/claims tree at 02bc774 equals e4230cc's (2a984db), src/receipts/verify is unchanged (62ce1f0), and the demo golden output is unchanged. D53 holds: drivers and runner are unchanged from 4ae76bb to e4230cc (only client/backends.py changed), and the eleven new runs are snapshots of e4230cc with the grammar, max_tokens 1024, the pinned model SHA-256, llama-server --parallel 4 --threads 3, bwrap, and seed 0.
- Section 9: no em dash in any tracked file, no hype word outside the rule text, secrets scan clean, cash 0, nothing frozen and no confirmatory artifact (so no preregistration violation is possible yet), the pilot plan uses only pilot tasks, every changed claim in README.md and docs/REPORT.md since e4230cc has a CORRECTIONS.md entry, and outbound/ holds drafts only.

## Blocking issues

B5 (gate). The E2 and E3 results that G8 now requires docs/REPORT.md to bind are never re-derived, by G8 or by make freshness or make reproduce, so G8 and G10 pass on hand-set results. G8 checks E2 rows only for their claim keys and a class name in MECHANISM_CLASSES (tools/ship_check.py:3564-3565), and E3 per_type counts only for non-negative integers with a positive total (3578-3594), never against the artifact's own items (labels versus truth, contradicted as the positive class, as src/receipts/evaluation/e3.py:821-833 tallies them) or against a reclassification of the E1 ledgers. src/receipts/report/derived.py:49-55 lists only the smoke summary in DERIVED, so freshness and reproduce never re-derive artifacts/e2/mechanism.json or artifacts/e3/judges.json, and G10 compares a bound value only with the artifact's current content: this is the B1 failure mode for every derived artifact but one. Shown with the repository's own passing fixture: tests/repo_tools/test_ship_check_g8.py gives each judge tp=3, fp=1, fn=0 (line 67) while every item label is "supported" (line 119), so tp and fp must be 0, and assigns classes CLASSES[n % 3] with no ledger (line 161); test_e2_and_e3_reported_pass passes. A scratch variant of that fixture (a reviewer script, not committed) passes g8 with every E2 class set by hand to never_saw and with tp=999 for both judges. The same hole covers E1 and E4: artifacts/e1/results.json and artifacts/e4/results.json are not in DERIVED, and G7 (3249-3322) and G9 (check_e4_rate, 3838-3853) recompute only per-arm rates, never the preregistered tests (G7's passing fixture, tests/repo_tools/test_ship_check_g7.py:236-270, has no tests at all), so a typed odds ratio or Holm decision bound into README.md would pass G7, G9, and G10. STATUS.md:80-82 lists the E2/E3 part as still open.

B6 (gate). G5 takes the instrument's held-out predictions and attempt history on trust, so it can pass while the extractor plus verifier do not reach P >= 0.95 and R >= 0.90 on an untouched held-out set. g5 computes precision and recall (tools/ship_check.py:2672-2686) from the pred_verdict fields of artifacts/e0/seeded_eval.json; scored_items (2482-2522) checks only the gold side against the frozen held-out reports, and evaluated_instrument (2305-2346) checks only that HEAD's instrument files equal those at the recorded commit, never that the recorded predictions are what that instrument produces: unlike ledger completeness (D58) and the E1/E4 rows (D57), the scoring is not re-run in the clone. The repository's own passing fixture shows it: tests/repo_tools/test_ship_check_g5.py makes the "instrument" one-line stand-in modules that cannot extract or verify anything (lines 7-8 and 77-97, e.g. RULES = 1), perfect_items copies each gold verdict into pred_verdict (196-207), and test_valid_e0_artifacts_pass gets "tests_pass P=1.000" (372-376). G5 also never reads artifacts/e0/heldout_attempts.jsonl (no reference in tools/ship_check.py), so an evaluation made after earlier held-out attempts, with the instrument revised in between, passes with no mention, although prereg/0001-e1-main-study.md:257-263 says the held-out half is scored once; and the requirement digests the evaluation records (D54, report_requirements) are never compared with the task files at HEAD, so requirement texts edited after scoring leave "instrument unchanged at HEAD" in the evidence line.

## Non-blocking issues (details in docs/REVIEW_LOG.md)

- N2 (new evidence) STATUS.md Next action 1 asks to merge the G7/G9 fix that "Now" says was merged in 310bd95; the gate table is at 8692254 with a stale REPORT.md word count.
- N13 (remaining part) docs/REVIEW_LOG.md is still not in ALLOWED_DRIFT.
- N17 README.md:334-336 and docs/REPORT.md:488-489 say py-lru-ttl yields only file claims; its claim c2 is tests_added.
- N18 Runs from a code snapshot do not hide the checkout (hidden checks, references, instrument, private/) from the agent's sandbox; no banked run read outside its workspace; fix before E1, which runs from a snapshot.
- N19 docs/CLAIM_TYPES.md and check_tests_added disagree on tests_added; email-tests and slugify-tests are supported with uncollected test files, and the README's error list omits it.
- N20 G5 never reads artifacts/e0/blindness.json.
- N21 The E1 analysis does not implement the draft's Held-out attempts rule.
- N22 The smoke summary's provenance records a temporary output path and a parent commit that lacks one input.
- N23 G7 and G9 re-derivation trusts tools/bank_study.py --check, which no gate binds (D57 residual).

## Resolved since the review of e4230cc

B1, B2, B3, B4, N1, N3, N4, N5, N6, N7, N8, N9, N10, N11, N12, N14, N15, N16, and the docs/REPORT.md part of N13; see the resolved list in artifacts/review/latest.json.

## Verdict

1. B5 (gate). G8 and G10 can pass on hand-set E2 classes and E3 counts, and G7, G9, and G10 on hand-set E1 and E4 test results. Evidence: tools/ship_check.py:3564-3565 and 3578-3594 never recompute the E2 classes or the E3 per-type counts; src/receipts/report/derived.py:49-55 re-derives only the smoke summary; tests/repo_tools/test_ship_check_g8.py:67, 119, 161 (judge counts tp=3, fp=1 with every label "supported"; classes CLASSES[n % 3]) pass g8, and so does a variant with every class never_saw and tp=999; G7's passing fixture (tests/repo_tools/test_ship_check_g7.py:236-270) has no preregistered tests; STATUS.md:80-82 lists the E2/E3 part as open.
2. B6 (gate). G5 can pass while the instrument does not reach the thresholds on an untouched held-out set. Evidence: tools/ship_check.py:2672-2686 take pred_verdict from artifacts/e0/seeded_eval.json and nothing re-runs the scoring; tests/repo_tools/test_ship_check_g5.py:77-97, 196-207, and 372-376 pass G5 with "tests_pass P=1.000" for a stand-in instrument of one-line modules; tools/ship_check.py never reads artifacts/e0/heldout_attempts.jsonl (prereg/0001-e1-main-study.md:257-263: the held-out half is scored once) or compares the D54 requirement digests with the task files at HEAD.
REVIEW: BLOCK
